title: Software-Defined Stochastic Inference Engine (SDSIE): Energy-Proportional LLM Serving via Fused SRAM Dequantization and Entropy-Gated Speculative Control
description: The Software-Defined Stochastic Inference Engine (SDSIE) is an open-source GPU inference runtime layer engineered to reduce the electrical energy and DRAM bandwidth overhead of Large Language Model (LLM) autoregressive generation. SDSIE combines custom OpenAI Triton sub-byte SRAM dequantization GEMM kernels (–75% HBM bus traffic, 28.6 µs isolated latency) with a deterministic Schmitt-trigger stochastic clutch (k=5 confident ↔ k=0 uncertain fallback), cutting end-to-end inference power by 46.7% (6.40 J to 3.41 J/token) on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Blackwell hardware.
